subject: Contract review choreography: proposed cadence & checkpoint windows
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@emeraldapps.com>, procurement@emeraldapps.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Contract review choreography: proposed cadence & checkpoint windows

Hi Elena / Emerald procurement team —

Thanks again for sending over the redlines. To keep momentum and avoid a long back-and-forth over email, I want to propose a compact cadence for the next week: a 45-minute MSA redline workshop (legal + procurement) followed by a 30-minute onboarding checkpoint with the implementation leads.

Proposed windows (all in CET — please let me know if you prefer local times):
- Option A: Mon 30 Nov, 10:00–10:45 CET — MSA redline workshop
- Option B: Tue 1 Dec, 14:00–14:45 CET — MSA redline workshop

For the onboarding checkpoint (implementation + SSO/SCIM + timeline):
- Same-day follow-up: 11:00–11:30 CET (after Option A) or 15:00–15:30 CET (after Option B)

Attachments: Emerald_MSA_redlines_v2.pdf (I synced our consolidated comments) and onboarding-checklist.xlsx (initial ops checklist).

If neither window works, share one or two 60–90 minute blocks and we’ll adjust. Goal is to get legal alignment and a concrete action list so we can lock the pilot schedule.

Next steps from our side: I’ll prepare a focused agenda for the redline workshop (top 5 items + fallback positions) and add a brief risk/rollback note for procurement.

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Manager, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@emeraldapps.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@emeraldapps.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Contract review choreography: proposed cadence & checkpoint windows

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear proposal. We're keen to move quickly. A couple of notes on availability: our legal lead (Tim Smyth) is OOO Friday and Monday morning we have a regional holiday in our office. That makes Option A tricky. Option B (Tue 1 Dec) looks good for the MSA workshop if we start at 14:00 CET.

Suggested schedule (Emerald side):
- Tue 1 Dec, 14:00–14:45 CET — MSA redline workshop (Tim + Procurement + Elena)
- Tue 1 Dec, 15:00–15:30 CET — Onboarding checkpoint (Ops + Integration)

Questions:
1) Can you confirm whether the workshop should expect final legal redlines or is this still a working draft?
2) Will you be sharing a proposed fallback clause for data residency during the workshop?

We can accept the attachments you sent — I'll circulate Emerald's comments ahead of the call.

Elena
Head of Procurement, Emerald Apps

Priyom —

Thanks for putting this together. Tue 1 Dec 14:00 CET (our 05:00 PST) is a little early for our US legal reviewer but workable if Marcus and I can cover the majority of legal ops items; I'll flag the key redline themes (data residency, liability cap, audit rights) and drop a 1-pager into the meeting notes before the call.

Marcus — can you confirm you can take the lead on the data residency fallback language?

Also adding to the agenda: clarification on logging/audit retention windows and the timeline for SOC evidence handoff.

Laura
VP, Legal — Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick reply and for flagging Tim's schedule. Confirmed:

Final schedule (confirmed):
- Tue 1 Dec, 14:00–14:45 CET — MSA redline workshop (Zoom) — invite to follow.
- Tue 1 Dec, 15:00–15:30 CET — Onboarding checkpoint (Zoom) — invite to follow.

To answer your questions: this will be a working redline workshop — please send any final comments before EOD Mon 30 Nov so we can consolidate. Marcus will bring a proposed fallback clause for data residency; I’ll email that clause as a one-page insert to the meeting notes.

I’ve attached the consolidated redlines (Emerald_MSA_redlines_v2.pdf) and the implementation checklist. Please expect calendar invites in CET and a shared Google Doc for live editing during the call.

Agenda items (top five):
1) Liability cap and exceptions
2) Data residency fallback language (Marcus)
3) Audit/logging retention windows (Laura)
4) SSO/SCIM timeline and test plan
5) Post-go-live support SLA and rollback triggers

If anything changes on your side, ping procurement@emeraldapps.com and cc me.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Manager, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
